title: Major disaster declaration DR-4897-KS: Severe Storm
summary: FEMA records a major disaster declaration (DR-4897-KS, "SEVERE STORMS, STRAIGHT-LINE WINDS, AND FLOODING") for KS, dated 2025-12-19, for an incident of type "Severe Storm". The incident period began on 2025-07-17 and ended on 2025-07-22. The declaration lists 12 designated areas.
